title: Western Harbour Tunnel Project-Specific Application Accuracy Contract Instantiation

frozen_project.project_name: Western Harbour Tunnel and Warringah Freeway Upgrade
frozen_project.qoi: groundwater head/drawdown prediction at decision-relevant receptors and monitoring locations

purpose: Attempt the first concrete project-specific instantiation of the canonical coupling application-accuracy contract. Admit a numerical temporal head budget only if project or regulator-controlled evidence independently supplies both an admissible numerical prediction-accuracy requirement H_app and an admissible temporal/coupling allocation A_temporal, each with provenance.
fail_closed_rule: If either a project-specific numerical prediction-accuracy requirement or an independently governed temporal/coupling allocation is absent, no positive numerical budget is materialized and no production coupling claim follows.
